name: Tuscan Bread Salad (Panzanella) with Bacon, Peaches & Fresh Mozzarella

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 small pkgs grape tomatoes
6 peaches
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 5-6 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer bacon to a paper towel-lined plate, leaving the drippings in the skillet.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp honey
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, cut or tear bread into bite-sized pieces.
Return skillet (with bacon drippings) to low heat. Add bread and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and crisp, 5-6 minutes. Remove from the heat.
While the croutons are cooking, peel, halve, and slice onion into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers; add to the bowl.
Trim and medium dice cucumbers; halve tomatoes. Add both to the bowl.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Medium dice each quarter and add to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; add to the bowl.
Medium dice mozzarella and add to the bowl along with the croutons; toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (227 g) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with bacon and enjoy!
